reasoning: By the pigeonhole principle, placing 11 pigeons into 10 holes with at most one pigeon per hole is impossible because 11 > 10.
cot_trace: We need to place 11 pigeons into 10 holes, each hole at most one pigeon. That's the pigeonhole principle: 11 pigeons into 10 holes means at least one hole must have two pigeons, but condition says each hole contains at most one pigeon. So it's impossible. Thus UNSAT.
